front.title: L3 fast convergence for all-active multi-homing for EVPN/ MVPN Seamless interoperation

abstract.t: This document specifies the procedures for achieving faster Layer-3 convergence from link/ node failures when all-active multi-homing is used with EVPN/ MVPN seamless interop [draft-ietf-bess-evpn-mvpn- seamless-interop]. Specifically, these improvements apply when L3 routed multicast services are deployed by BGP/ EVPN PEs using the procedures defined by the above draft.
